title: Evidence timestamps repaired
details: Repairs the evidence viewer so tapping an AC timestamp seeks the loaded recording to that exact time again
Fixes the 2.72 regression where the redesigned timestamp row could highlight without moving the video
Timestamp taps now drive the actual video element directly and load the correct LO recording first when needed
The streamlined one-tap Android ZIP permission flow and fixed-video scrolling layout are retained
The proven Milos 2.46 camera/media recording stack is unchanged
